title: Industrial Foregoing Mycelial Tweaks
description: Adds recipe system support for mycelial generators.
body:
Industrial Foregoing Mycelial Tweaks

Because hard-coding isn't fun with modpacks.

 

This mod changes how ten (10) mycelial generators with arbitrary items work by rewriting the underlying recipe system to use Minecraft's recipe system.

You also get built-in CraftTweaker integration (see example here) as well as light integration with KubeJS (see example here).

The currently supported mycelial generators:

  • Crimed Mycelial Generator
  • Death Mycelial Generator
  • Ender Mycelial Generator
  • Explosive Mycelial Generator
  • Frosty Mycelial Generator
  • Halitosis Mycelial Generator
  • Magma Mycelial Generator
  • Meatallurgic Mycelial Generator
  • Nether Star Mycelial Generator
  • Slimey Mycelial Generator

 

Permissions:

  • You can use this mod in your modpack.
  • You are not allowed to re-publish this mod to other sites without providing a CurseForge or Modrinth download link and my permission (PM to  Zeitheron, or via Discord)
  • You are not allowed to include this (or any other mods of the DragonForge team) in your own mod. Building add-ons, however, is allowed, but a friendly PM would be good.

Note:

  • The only supported version of Minecraft is the latest one for which this mod exists. DO NOT ASK TO DOWNGRADE!
